title: PEEP / FiO₂ Ladders (ARDSNet)
sources: Critical Vector — Vent Pocket Guide: PEEP/FiO2 Ladder
ARDS Network (NEJM 2000); ALVEOLI / LOVS / EXPRESS higher-PEEP trials

changelog.change: Initial entry — both ARDSNet ladders and the oxygenation goal.

summary: Titrate PEEP and FiO₂ together off a fixed ladder to reach the oxygenation goal (PaO₂ 55–80 mmHg / SpO₂ 88–95%). Two ladders exist — a lower-PEEP and a higher-PEEP version. Pick one and stay on it; they are not interchangeable mid-course without recalculating from the current FiO₂.

body.text: PaO₂ 55–80 mmHg, or SpO₂ 88–95%. Adjust up or down the ladder to stay in that band; do not chase a normal PaO₂.

The higher-PEEP strategy has a mortality signal in the subgroup with moderate–severe ARDS (P/F ≤ 200) and in meta-analysis, but not in mild ARDS, where it adds haemodynamic cost. Reasonable to start higher-PEEP for P/F ≤ 150–200; verify recruitability (oxygenation and compliance improve, not just pressure rises) and do a decremental PEEP trial to find the working PEEP. Keep plateau pressure ≤ 30 and driving pressure < 15 cmH₂O.
